description: Retrieve the PetalPal care guide for an exact plant_id returned by search_plants: light, watering, temperature, feeding or flower food, first steps, daily care, FAQs and pet notes. Includes the original page, available references and editorial status. General reference, not photo identification or a diagnosis; never substitute cut-flower care for a rooted plant.

language.description: Language of the returned guide. Use zh-Hans for Simplified Chinese; en for English. Plant-name search works across all languages.

plant_id.description: Exact plant_id from search_plants, such as pothos, rose (cut flower) or rose-pot (rooted potted rose).
